title: Martian survivors fled and some may have reached Earth

tellings.quote: I think there were people that got stuck on Mars and tried to survive by hibernating

plain: Mars once had people on it, and some of them got stuck there and tried to survive by hibernating, while others may have fled and reached Earth. That is what Joe McMoneagle, a remote viewer (someone who says he can describe faraway places and times with his mind alone), tells Michels. He gives it as his own view, with no other source, and if true it would mean humans or their ancestors might have Martian roots.
